title: フィリーズレビューの後に・カワイイ夢

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After reflecting on the race, Curren Chan decides to give up on the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Instead, she changes her goal to becoming the most beloved runner, believing it will help her traverse the path to cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, we set the pinnacle of all sprints—the Sprinters Stakes—as her next race. We also add the Aoi Stakes as a way for her to get reacclimated to sprints before that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's not all. Curren Chan also seems to be cooking up some other plan outside of her races and training.
